name: se-eli-mcp
description: Swedish statutes with verifiable citations, from the Swedish Code of Statutes (SFS) through the Riksdag's open-data API (data.riksdagen.se): search statutes and fetch a consolidated act's metadata and text by SFS number. Every answer carries the official source, so a citation can be checked instead of trusted. Queries go only to the Riksdag's open data; nothing goes to MateMatic.
